observations: Header is centered and bounded in restored and maximized windows, with rendered histogram and Back, Undo, Compare, More and Export actions.
Light inspector displays Profile plus Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites and Blacks. Seven primary tool labels are visible.
More menu opens with Auto adjust, Reset all, Revert, Lens corrections, Film looks, Heal / Clone, Presets, Geometry, Brightness and Scopes.
Escape dismisses the menu and displays focus on its trigger. Native maximize and restore retain the selected third photo and active Light group.
Photo retains its aspect ratio with side letterboxing; the different photograph is not stretched to match the design illustration.
limitations: Right-edge drag did not resize the window. Required 1024x768 and 1440x900 physical-window screenshots remain missing.
Physical DPI was not established by logical screenshot dimensions.
Menu visibility establishes discoverability only, not complete functional or Narrator qualification.
Screenshots remain local because they contain personal photos.
No full UI, pixel-parity or hardware-performance sign-off.
